gitCommit.body:
Merge PR #131: explanation authoring and draft retention

Adopt the combined #129/#130 increment with reviewed draft-retention fixes. Exact-head qualification and independently verified artifact evidence are recorded in PR #131. Existing immutable packages remain preserved; the resulting main commit requires its own deployment and package receipts.
